editorial_rules: Collect only concise news metadata and short summaries; do not download, store, or reproduce full article bodies.
Every item must be a specific article or official announcement, never a homepage, category page, search page, index, sitemap, market quote page or directory.
Every item must show a sequence number, a complete English headline, one concise English brief, and its Chinese translation immediately on the next line.
Use the article headline as a clickable direct link to the specific original article. Also show the full plain-text URL on a separate Copy link line so readers can select and copy it.
Email clients do not reliably support clipboard JavaScript; provide the raw URL as selectable text rather than a nonfunctional copy button.
Prioritize official company announcements, government and regulator releases, and reliable media.
Distinguish completed, formally announced/planned, reported/under negotiation, and unverified.
Include investor, destination country/region, sector, deal or policy action, amount and currency only when supported; otherwise mark not disclosed or unavailable.
Separate event date from publication date; do not infer missing dates.
Do not turn a search snippet into an established fact. Use a cautious brief and clearly flag unverified information.
Exclude routine stock and bond price movements, generic market commentary, fund rankings, company directories, old evergreen explainers and unrelated stories.
No full-text extraction, no paragraph-by-paragraph translation, no vocabulary list and no American IPA.
Keep the email visually clean: only two sections, numbered entries, one English line followed by one Chinese line, and a source/copy URL line.
